articles.title: Calls of the wild offer sound guidance for protecting animals
articles.snippet: The wild world is full of roars, whoops and songs. Scientists are using such sounds to guide efforts to help save species at threat of extinction.
articles.summary: Scientists are using animal roars, whoops, and songs to help guide efforts to save species that are at risk of extinction. By listening to these calls from the wild, researchers can better protect endangered animals.
